400.text: At 400 cells per sample, the mixing control does not work: even a 25% young spike-in is not detected in 80% of draws. A null result from an experiment at this depth could not be read.

1200.text: At 1,200 cells per sample, the mixing control would detect a quarter-gap approach (a 25% young spike-in) but not a tenth-gap one (a 10% young spike-in). An effect smaller than a quarter of the donor gap would be undetectable by construction at this depth.
